summary: Join our Counterparty Risk and Management Training Course to gain vital insights and practical skills for effective risk assessment and management in finance.
lede: Counterparty risk management helps teams measure exposure and control contractual, collateral and concentration risks. This course is for professionals working with credit decisions, traded products, treasury relationships, legal documentation, collateral or risk data. Practical exercises develop skills to calculate SA-CCR exposure and potential future exposure, check netting eligibility and collateral controls, and monitor limits and emerging threats through scorecards, dashboards and escalation workflows.
audienceIntro: This counterparty risk training is designed for professionals who already work with credit decisions, traded products, treasury relationships, legal documentation, collateral, or risk data. It is particularly relevant when you need to explain exposure calculations, challenge netting assumptions, investigate limit breaches, or present counterparty deterioration to senior governance forums.
prerequisites: Prior knowledge: Working knowledge of credit risk, treasury, derivatives, securities financing, collateral, or financial risk reporting is expected. Technology: Completion requires spreadsheet skills rather than programming. Bring a laptop capable of running Microsoft Excel; Microsoft Power BI Desktop is recommended for the dashboard exercise, with an alternative template available where installation is restricted. Preparation: You may bring an anonymized counterparty policy, limit report, collateral workflow, or exposure report for structured reflection.
